name: Platinum Industries Ltd
title: Platinum Industries Ltd - 544134 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue INR 132 cr (+37% YoY) and EBITDA margin 11.6%, but FY27 guidance of 40%+ growth rests on a new Palghar CPVC additive line and an Egypt plant starting Q3 FY27, with capacity and utilisation largely undisclosed.

utilisation.quote: CPVC is running at optimal around 70% to 80%

capex.quote: in Egypt, we are putting up the similar CapEx and with similar facility around 60,000 metric tonnes per annum

triggers.label: CPVC utilisation 70-80%
triggers.quote: CPVC is running at optimal around 70% to 80%

triggers.label: FY27 growth >40%; 35% CAGR FY26-29
triggers.quote: targeting more than 40% revenue growth in financial year '27 and a 35% CAGR from financial year '26 to '29

triggers.label: Raw-material pre-buying in March
triggers.quote: In March, we had procured quite a lot of raw materials. I think we built a higher inventory than the normal levels

triggers.label: Raw-material pass-through lagging
triggers.quote: there is a time lag in passing on the margins

guidance.quote: targeting more than 40% revenue growth in financial year '27
a 35% CAGR from financial year '26 to '29
we're targeting somewhere around INR 55 crores to INR 60 crores in oleo chemicals
About 10% of the topline will come from Egypt operation
The plant is going to commence production in Q3 FY27
around 30% to 35% is decent enough to breakeven

red_flags.label: Standalone vs consolidated growth gap
red_flags.quote: On a consolidated basis, revenue from operations stood at INR 132 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 37%

red_flags.label: Net debt disclosed only as 'minimal'; working capital stretched
red_flags.quote: Working capital was calibrated to support growth with normalization expected going forward.

red_flags.label: Palghar capacity and utilisation not disclosed
red_flags.quote: So far, we have put up only facility for manufacturing CPVC. So, once we commence the -- install the remaining facility, then we will be in position to answer the question.

red_flags.label: Oleo revenue is outsourced trading, not own capacity
red_flags.quote: we are getting the product manufactured from a contract manufacturer and selling it in the market

evasions.quote: So, once we commence the -- install the remaining facility, then we will be in position to answer the question.

evasions.topic: CPVC market share and competitive landscape
evasions.quote: But looking at the landscape of CPVC, I cannot really give you a number
So, it is an ongoing process. We keep passing on to the maximum possible.
